notes.x: delivery (last-mile) emissions per loaded vehicle-mile, kg CO2e; model r_L = x/(20*0.1375); electric truck 0.44, diesel truck 1.375 (calibrated default for both products)
notes.rt: r_t = carbon intensity of faster inbound service, kg CO2e per extra dollar spent on speed (epsilon_0/t_1); set_rt keeps cost schedule and emissions at the slowest speed fixed. 0.03 = calibrated perishables (team drivers, speed bought with labor); 1.78 = calibrated reference network (rail vs truckload, speed bought with fuel)
notes.cut: least-cost (n, v) whose emissions are 25% below that scenario's own cost minimum; null = cut not attainable
notes.carbonmin: design minimizing emissions; at_slowest = line haul at slowest allowed speed (4 days); max_cut = deepest attainable cut
notes.scenarios: perishables = refrigerated dairy with spoilage, solo/team drivers (current Fig 3 top row); reference = $50k/pallet goods, rail-or-truckload, financed in transit (bottom row). lower/higher = pooling at stake (omega)
